sloka: भरतस्य वच: कुर्वन् याचमानस्य राघव ।आत्मानं नातिवर्त्तेस्त्वं सत्यधर्मपराक्रम ॥ २.१११.७॥
transliteration: bharatasya vaca: kurvan yācamānasya rāghava ।ātmānaṁ nātivarttestvaṁ satyadharmaparākrama ॥ 2.111.7॥

translations.english: O scion of the Raghus whose strength springs from truth and righteousness, if you accede to the prayers of Bharata, you will not ignore the call of your soul.
